acceptanceCriteria: An accepted spec slice defines the Corvint Claude Code mod: surfaces, events, version gate (Claude Code 2.1.287+ terminal, 2.1.286+ desktop), and fallback to the existing hooks.json adapter where mods do not run (claude -p, Agent SDK, VS Code panel, cloud, WSL).
The mod never approves or rewrites a tool call; it may only observe, display, or deny, and it holds no authority (AGENTS.md invariants 3 and 4).
The mod starts no long-lived process and keeps no database (invariant 7).
Live qualification on the installed Claude Code shows the pane, status line and guards working, with NOT_RUN for unsupported surfaces.
body: Claude Code now supports mods: in-process JS plugins that can draw panes, prompt bands, toasts and status lines, add slash commands and tools, and guard or annotate tool calls (docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview). They are not sandboxed and run with user permissions. Corvint's Claude Code adapter today is hooks.json command hooks with 2 s timeouts; this session repeatedly shows corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-deadline degradations and large untrusted JSON envelopes injected into model context. Candidate uses: (1) status line and band showing context coverage, degradations, dogfood lifecycle and v1.0 ticket counts instead of model-facing JSON; (2) a pane for roadmap, readiness and CEM/review state; (3) /corvint commands for context, affected, tasks; (4) deny-only PreToolUse guards, e.g. push before dogfood-seal; (5) compaction pin verification shown to the user; (6) async event dispatch to avoid the 2 s deadline. Needs a spec (invariant 8), security review of an unsandboxed in-process module, and must keep the hooks.json path as fallback. Not on the 1.0 critical path unless the owner says so.
title: Claude Code mod adapter: user-facing Corvint status, panes and deny-only guards
